prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a modern black laptop sitting on a wooden table in a softly lit room. The laptop screen displays a detailed, vintage-style anatomical diagram of a tiger, labeled "Tiger Parts Used in Chinese Medicine," with various body parts annotated in fine black text and thin lines. The illustration of the tiger is rendered in a muted reddish-brown, standing in profile against a pale, off-white background. The scene is bathed in natural daylight streaming through a window in the softly blurred background, creating a gentle, warm ambiance. The composition is intimate and focused, with the laptop angled slightly to the right, drawing attention to the screen’s content. In the foreground, out of focus, is a hint of a gray object, possibly a bag or piece of clothing, adding depth and a sense of lived-in realism. The overall color palette is subdued and earthy, with soft browns, grays, and warm neutrals. The camera employs a shallow depth of field, keeping the laptop and its screen in sharp focus while the background and foreground remain softly blurred, evoking a contemplative, documentary-like atmosphere.
